title: Merge About and Settings into unified /settings layout with subpages and update sidebar

requirements.description: Sidebar: Remove Giới thiệu icon from appbar/sidebar, retain Settings icon pointing to /settings, and update menu-bg slider positions

Settings Drawer Layout: Migrate drawer layout from gioi-thieu to src/routes/settings/+layout.svelte with 3 items in order: Cài đặt (/settings), Về chúng tôi (/settings/about), and Tài liệu (/settings/docs)
Pages Migration: Move settings UI into src/routes/settings/+page.svelte, about UI into src/routes/settings/about/+page.svelte, and docs UI into src/routes/settings/docs/+page.svelte
Link & Legacy Migration: Update old links across the app (Footer, UserMenu, Profile) to new /settings paths and ensure backward compatibility / redirects
